title: Page title
description: PageTitle is the 18 / 400 UI sans heading of a work page on the same row as the page's main action (`actions`), with `variant="reading"` (44 / 500 display face, text-title-xl) for one-column reading pages only. PageTabsTitle is kept as a deprecated alias for 2–4 sibling tabs — new screens use TextTabs.
when: The first line of every page (PageTitle).
A list page's title row: the title and the page's action (one primary or secondary, plus RefreshButton) above a StickyContextBar (PageTitle actions).

instead.need: 2–4 top-level views as the page heading
5+ sections of a page, or sections with icons
2–5 filter values shown in full, with counts
Tabs inside a card or panel
The top row of a detail or settings page (a Breadcrumb and one action)

a11y: PageTitle is the page h1; its actions follow it in the reading and tab order. PageTabsTitle is a tablist with arrow-key navigation.
notes: No subtitle under the title. Title-row actions are one primary (or secondary) with icon and text, optionally a RefreshButton before it; more actions go in a ⋯ Menu. Filters never go on the title row: they belong in the StickyContextBar or SubpageToolbar under it.
Below sm the actions wrap onto their own row under the title.
A page whose SubpageToolbar carries the actions leaves `actions` out.
